name: The intake wheel
hint: The maintenance plate shows: side channel, then release the intake. Keep the archive pipe closed.
success: Water settles into the side channel. The maintenance gate is raised.

name: The loaded carts
hint: A floor sketch marks the heavy cart at rail position 2, and the light cart at position 1. Carts stay on their rails.
success: Both plates settle. The counterweight lifts the archive grille.

name: The three sluices
hint: The pump diagram has two open branches around a closed centre: open, closed, open. A wrong release drains only this lock.
success: The salt lock drains. A dry passage leads to the chart room.

name: The freight balance
hint: The maker's scale reads: two blocks left, one block right. The lift stays parked until the load is balanced.
success: The lift rises evenly. Its brake locks onto the upper landing.

name: The cooling ducts
hint: Follow the numbered workshop plates: east vent, north vent, west vent. A wrong vent resets the sequence safely.
success: Cool air crosses the floor. The insulated shutter is safe to approach.

name: The reflector rail
hint: The rail mark is 1. Face the reflector west. Its beam must meet the shutter sensor, never the wrapped lens.
success: The sensor warms and the storage shutter slides aside.

name: The wind shutters
hint: The sheltered crossing is marked: west half open, east fully open. Wait for the blue wind ribbons before crossing.
success: The wind takes the upper channel. The gallery crossing is sheltered.

name: The captive gears
hint: The large gear seats at notch 2; the small gear at notch 3. Both remain captive on the work rails.
success: The gears mesh without strain. The meridian platform unlocks.

name: The meridian plates
hint: The survey note reads north, west, east. Touch each fixed plate in that order; the escape stair is independent.
success: The meridian marks align. The compass gallery opens to the morning sky.
